columns.name: SOURCE
columns.description: Source of the intercompany transaction.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Oracle Enterprise Scheduler: request identifier of the interface load job that created the row.

columns.name: GROUP_ID
columns.description: Group identifier that is populated automatically for Oracle Cloud customers by the Load Interface File for Import program. Otherwise, use a positive integer.

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.description: Batch identifier that is populated automatically for Oracle Cloud customers. Otherwise, use a positive integer.

columns.name: BATCH_NUMBER
columns.description: Intercompany batch number. Used if the Intercompany System Options Batch Numbering property is not set to Automatic. Must be a positive integer.

columns.name: INITIATOR_ID
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Initiator identifier.

columns.name: INITIATOR_NAME
columns.description: Initiator name. Use the Manage Intercompany Organizations task to identify valid values.

columns.name: FROM_LE_ID
columns.description: Oracle internal use only.  Identifies the from legal entity for the intercompany batch.

columns.name: FROM_LE_NAME
columns.description: From legal entity name. Use the Manage Intercompany Organizations task to identify valid values.

columns.name: FROM_LEDGER_ID
columns.description: From ledger identifier. Use the Use the Manage Primary Ledgers task to identify valid values.

columns.name: CONTROL_TOTAL
columns.description: Control total amount.  Amount must be equal to RUNNING_TOTAL_DR and equal to RUNNING_TOTAL_CR.

columns.name: RUNNING_TOTAL_CR
columns.description: Running total credit.

columns.name: RUNNING_TOTAL_DR
columns.description: Running total debit.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency of the intercompany batch. Use the Manage Currencies task to identify valid values. The three character ISO code must be used. Example: US Dollars is USD.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE_TYPE
columns.description: Type of exchange rate. Use the Manage Conversion Rate Types task to identify valid values.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Intercompany interface batch description. Free text field. Not validated.

columns.name: TRX_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Transaction type identifier. You can also use TRX_TYPE_CODE or TRX_TYPE_NAME.

columns.name: TRX_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Transaction type code. Use the Manage Intercompany Transaction Types task to identify valid values. Use either TRX_TYPE_CODE or TRX_TYPE_NAME, but not both.

columns.name: TRX_TYPE_NAME
columns.description: Transaction type name. Use the Manage Intercompany Transaction Types task to identify valid values. Use either TRX_TYPE_CODE or TRX_TYPE_NAME, but not both.

columns.name: GL_DATE
columns.description: Effective date of the batch. Used to assign the accounting period.

columns.name: BATCH_DATE
columns.description: Batch date of the intercompany batch. Date format: YYYY/MM/DD.

columns.name: REJECT_ALLOWED_FLAG
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Reject allowed option. Populated by Import Intercompany Transactions process.

columns.name: FROM_RECURRING_BATCH_ID
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. From recurring batch identifier.

columns.name: CREATED_BY

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: IMPORT_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Import status code. Populated by the interface import program.

columns.name: NOTE
columns.description: Note for providing descriptive information. Free text field. Not validated.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is increased every time the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
